December 6, 2023


# Lessons on Democratizing Healthcare Analytics: Tuva featured on the Pear Healthcare Playbook Podcast


Aaron and Coco discuss their founder story, the healthcare data problem, and why Tuva is building open infrastructure for analytics.


Tuva co-founders Aaron Neiderhiser and Coco Zuloaga joined the Pear Healthcare Playbook Podcast to talk about their path into healthcare analytics and why they started Tuva.


The episode covers the repeated infrastructure work healthcare data teams face and why Tuva is making the core transformation layer open source.


[Listen to Episode](https://pearhealthcareplaybook.substack.com/p/lessons-from-aaron-neiderhiser-and)
